scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:safari
scripts.build:chrome: node scripts/build-extension.mjs chrome && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/build-extension.mjs firefox && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs firefox
scripts.build:safari: node scripts/build-extension.mjs safari && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs safari
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.verify:safari: npm run convert:safari && xcodebuild -project 'Safari/Lectio Sync/Lectio Sync.xcodeproj' -scheme 'Lectio Sync (macOS)' -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .build/xcode-macos CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
